title: Quang Ngai in a day
summary: A day on the Trà Khúc, then Sơn Mỹ and this city’s Mỹ Khê. The weekend night street runs 17:00–22:00. Time on each stop is check on arrival.

days.title: The river, the memorial, then the sand
days.body: Start on the Trà Khúc. In May and June the newspaper’s peak for don is the river mouth at the end of Trường Sa. Give the late morning to Sơn Mỹ, 13 km northeast on the bureau page and about 12 km from cầu Trà Khúc 1 on the library page. The swim, if you still have the afternoon, is Mỹ Khê at Cổ Lũy, 12 km east, not the beach in Đà Nẵng. On Friday, Saturday, or Sunday the night street on Tôn Đức Thắng runs 17:00–22:00. Fees, hours, and the minutes between stops are check on arrival.

stops.name: Tra Khuc
stops.note: The river the city is built on. A timed walk was not printed.

stops.name: Son My
stops.note: The memorial at Tịnh Khê. Not a five-minute photo stop. The office prints no fee.

stops.name: My Khe of Quang Ngai
stops.note: The sand at Cổ Lũy, 12 km east. Not the beach in Đà Nẵng.

seoTitle: Quang Ngai in a day — river, Son My, My Khe
seoDescription: One day in Quang Ngai: the Trà Khúc, Sơn Mỹ, and Mỹ Khê at Cổ Lũy. The weekend night street is 17:00–22:00. Minutes and fees are check on arrival.
